text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Aston Machan enters the Tenno Sho 
(Autumn)! The rematch between the Big 
Three with Daiwa Scarlet and Vodka becomes 
a reality!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The three declare that they will each be 
the one to win. Aston Machan rejoices that 
she's now part of the "good friends," and 
calls on them to make history together!
